svg.aria-label: A network boundary with three download arrows crossing it downward into the browser tab, and no arrow crossing back out.
svg.title: Everything crosses one way
svg.desc: Three network sources sit above the boundary: the GitHub Pages bundle, the jsDelivr CDN serving Pyodide and its wheels, and Google Fonts. All three arrows point down into the browser tab. Inside the tab the pipeline runs left to right: your file, a Web Worker that parses it, Pyodide running the Python statistics, the dashboard, and an optional PDF written back to your disk. No arrow leaves the tab, because there is no server to send anything to.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three things cross the network boundary. All three come in.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: There is no fourth arrow pointing back out, because there is nothing on the other end to point it at. NiftyStats has no backend.

svg.text: Your spreadsheet is read by the file picker, parsed in a worker, and handed to Python without ever touching the network.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The statistics are real CPython. Pyodide compiles it to WebAssembly, and pandas, numpy, scipy and scikit-learn run inside the tab.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The two third party requests are the Pyodide CDN and Google Fonts. They learn your IP address and nothing about your data.
